relations.label: cause
relations.meaning: Cause to outcome; retain any stated uncertainty.

relations.label: contributing_cause
relations.meaning: One contributing factor to outcome; does not assert sufficiency or exclusivity.

relations.label: mechanism_step
relations.meaning: Earlier link to next link in a described transmission mechanism.

relations.label: enables
relations.meaning: Resource or arrangement to activity it makes feasible; does not assert that the activity occurs.

relations.label: prevents
relations.meaning: Intervention or constraint to the outcome it inhibits; retain partial versus complete prevention.

relations.label: feedback
relations.meaning: From one process to another that also affects the first; use only when the return link is stated.

relations.label: association
relations.meaning: Associated variables or patterns; no causal or time direction is asserted.

relations.label: predicts
relations.meaning: Predictor to forecast outcome; statistical prediction does not imply causation.

relations.label: necessary_condition
relations.meaning: Requirement to the outcome requiring it; necessary does not mean sufficient.

relations.label: sufficient_condition
relations.meaning: Sufficient premise to entailed outcome within the stated model/scope; not a necessary condition.

relations.label: conditional_consequence
relations.meaning: Stated condition to consequence within that case, without asserting a universal necessary/sufficient rule.

relations.label: logical_implication
relations.meaning: Premise or model result to the conclusion derived from it; not automatically a causal effect.

relations.label: counterfactual_dependence
relations.meaning: Hypothetical change to the hypothetical outcome; retain the counterfactual status.

relations.label: similarity
relations.meaning: Points share a relevant property; no ranking or causal direction is asserted.

relations.label: contrast
relations.meaning: Points differ on an identified dimension; no causal direction is asserted.

relations.label: quantitative_comparison
relations.meaning: First quantity to comparator; state greater/less/equal, units, denominators and period in qualification.

relations.label: trade_off
relations.meaning: A benefit or objective to its associated cost or competing objective; do not invent a numerical exchange rate.

relations.label: alternative_explanation
relations.meaning: One explanation to a competing account of the same phenomenon; do not assert either is established.

relations.label: substitution
relations.meaning: Substitute to what it can replace; retain when and how far replacement is possible.

relations.label: complementarity
relations.meaning: One input or arrangement to another whose usefulness it enhances; not mere co-occurrence.

relations.label: evidence_for
relations.meaning: Evidence to the proposition it supports; support is not proof.

relations.label: evidence_against
relations.meaning: Evidence to the proposition it weakens or challenges; distinguish weakened from refuted.

relations.label: tests
relations.meaning: Test design or reported test to the hypothesis examined; record the outcome, if given, in qualification.

relations.label: robustness_check
relations.meaning: Alternative-specification or sample result to the focal finding it checks; do not assume the check succeeds.

relations.label: example_of
relations.meaning: Specific case to the general idea it illustrates; an example does not establish prevalence.

relations.label: defines
relations.meaning: Definition to the concept-bearing point it clarifies; preserve the defining boundaries.

relations.label: operationalizes
relations.meaning: Measurement or proxy rule to the theoretical concept it measures; proxy need not equal concept.

relations.label: part_of
relations.meaning: Component or subcategory to the whole; preserve exhaustive versus partial coverage.

relations.label: elaborates
relations.meaning: Added detail to the more general point; not new independent evidence by itself.

relations.label: scope_restriction
relations.meaning: Restriction to the proposition whose applicability it limits.

relations.label: exception
relations.meaning: Exceptional case to the general pattern it falls outside; preserve the size/scope of the exception.

relations.label: concession
relations.meaning: Acknowledged consideration to a maintained conclusion; not automatic refutation or a reversal.

relations.label: temporal_sequence
relations.meaning: Earlier event to later event; sequence alone does not imply causation.

relations.label: change_over_time
relations.meaning: Earlier state to later state; preserve the change, period and comparison basis.

relations.label: reason_for_argument
relations.meaning: Stated reason or premise to the assessment or recommendation it motivates; distinguish a reason from empirical evidence.

relations.label: goal_means
relations.meaning: Proposed action or instrument to the stated objective; does not assert success or verified author intent.
